text:
morgan: Postmortem follow-up: recurring KV eviction bursts during peak. We need specific runbook steps, exact commands for on-call, and clear owners + deadlines. Can we split work?
incident-bot: Postmortem link: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2026-03-kv-eviction-bursts. Artifacts + traces uploaded.
priya: I'll author the escalation table in the playbook. @ash can you write the minimal triage commands that on-call can run in the first 10 minutes?
ash: Sure. Drafted compact triage below, keeping it frictionless for paging flow:
ash: 1) Check pod health: kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide
ash: 2) Quick log search: kubectl logs -l app=runtime -n inference --tail 100 | grep -iE "evict|kv_cache|OOM|OOMKilled"
ash: 3) Snapshot metrics: curl -fsS http://monitoring.internal/api/metrics?svc=runtime | jq '.kv_cache.evictions, .mem.rss, .gpu.util'
ash: 4) If evictions > 50/min -> patch lower batch size and restart gateway:
ash:    kubectl patch configmap rt-config -n inference --type merge -p '{"data":{"batch_size":"1"}}'
ash:    kubectl rollout restart deployment/rt-gateway -n inference
ash: 5) After restart, run warmup smoke: curl -sS http://rt-gateway.internal/healthz && echo '{"prompt":"warmup"}' | http POST http://rt-gateway.internal/v1/generate
priya: For paging: page @oncall at 10m, if still > threshold page @runtime-leads at 25m, page @dedicated-esc and @support for paying customers immediately when incident impacts Dedicated tenants. I'll add this to the playbook.
dan: I'll be owner for updating docs/runbooks/kv-evictions.md and will open a PR. Target: PR opened by 2026-04-06, merge by 2026-04-09.
rachel: I'll create a small bash script for the smoke check and add it to the runbook as an executable snippet for on-call. Will push gist and link in PR.
morgan: Can we assign follow-up tickets now with owners + due dates? I'll track them in the postmortem follow-ups doc.
priya: Action list: 1) runbook update (dan) - INC-7950 - due 2026-04-09; 2) triage command snippets + smoke script (ash + rachel) - INC-7951 - due 2026-04-04; 3) escalation matrix + paging doc (priya) - INC-7952 - due 2026-04-03.
ash: ACK on INC-7951. I'll also include auth notes for rt-admin dump endpoints and a command to request a KV dump: curl -X POST -u svcbot:token http://rt-admin.internal/dump_kv | gzip -c > kv_dump.gz
dan: PR will include a note to run the weekly eviction-rate job that alerts runtime-leads if >3 spikes in 24h. Add as a follow-up item in INC-7950.
morgan: Good. Once PRs merge and INCs close, I'll mark the postmortem follow-up resolved. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
